# SD18 deterministic Human Paladin level 12 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 level-11 Aura of Justice fixture
# (tests/sd18_paladin_level11_aura_of_justice.rs) to level 12 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed,
# or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt
# / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-11 fixture's
# choice=choice:paladin_mercy selection (mercy:shaken) unchanged.
#
# The PF1 CRB Paladin class table's level-12 "Special" column reads "Mercy"
# only (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com)
# -- 12th IS a repeat-Mercy-grant level (the 3rd/6th/9th/12th cadence), so
# this fixture adds a FOURTH numbered mercy selection
# (choice:paladin_mercy_4:mercy:blinded), a 12th-level CRB tier addition
# (the verified 12th-level CRB tier additions are Blinded, Deafened,
# Paralyzed, and Stunned).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution execution,
# no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or execution, no
# Aura of Justice's own smite-sharing resolution, and no level-13+
# progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level12
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:12
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_4:mercy:blinded
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
